metaDescription: Protect your team with custom SPF lip balm from Perfect Imprints. Perfect for outdoor workers, events, and giveaways. Order bulk today!
introHtml: Custom SPF lip balm combines essential sun protection with your brand message, making it a practical giveaway for outdoor events, construction crews, or summer marketing campaigns. Unlike standard lip balm, SPF varieties shield lips from harmful UV rays while keeping them moisturized. Decorate white tubes with your logo using full-color printing or dome lids for a polished look. Options like the SPF 15 Lip Balm in Black Tube or the Chap Ice SPF 15 Lip Balm offer broad-spectrum protection that recipients will actually use.
heroAltText: Custom SPF lip balm in white tube with full color dome lid and logo imprint, UV protection for outdoor use
